inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The Michaelis-Menten kinetics plot: velocity (V) on the Y-axis against substrate concentration [S] on the X-axis, a hyperbolic curve rising from origin and saturating at Vmax; the Km marked at the substrate concentration where V = 1/2 Vmax; the 'Saturation' label at the plateau. A vector figure (no raster).
inventory.kypLocation: the registry visual (the top-left panel of the EnzymeKineticsMap)

inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The Lineweaver-Burk double-reciprocal plot: 1/V on the Y-axis against 1/[S] on the X-axis, a straight line with negative x-intercept at -1/Km and y-intercept at 1/Vmax; slope = m labeled; the three lines (uninhibited, competitive reversible, noncompetitive) demonstrating that reversible competitive inhibitors cross the uninhibited line whereas noncompetitive inhibitors do not. A vector figure (no raster).
inventory.kypLocation: the registry visual (the top-right panel of the EnzymeKineticsMap)

inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.visualPurpose: The Effects of enzyme inhibition comparison panels
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The Effects of enzyme inhibition panels: the Michaelis-Menten (V vs [S]) and Lineweaver-Burk (1/V vs 1/[S]) overlays showing uninhibited, competitive inhibitor (reversible), and noncompetitive inhibitor curves, demonstrating that competitive inhibition raises Km while Vmax is unchanged (curves cross on Lineweaver-Burk) and noncompetitive inhibition lowers Vmax while Km is unchanged (curves do not cross). A vector figure (no raster).
inventory.kypLocation: the registry visual (the bottom panel of the EnzymeKineticsMap)

inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The inhibition comparison table: rows = Resemble substrate, Overcome by ↑ [S], Bind site, Effect on Vmax, Effect on Km, Pharmacodynamics; columns = Competitive inhibitors reversible, Competitive inhibitors irreversible, Noncompetitive inhibitors. Pure text, no figures.

notes: Census (pdfimages + VLM): NO raster images on the page (pdfimages -list returned zero rows for pdf 250). The page has THREE vector figures (the Michaelis-Menten plot, the Lineweaver-Burk plot, the Effects of enzyme inhibition comparison panels) — all redrawn as ORIGINAL_KYP_REDRAW vector graphics in the registry visual (no photographs, no copyrighted artwork reproduced). The 5-row inhibition comparison table is pure text and is carried verbatim in the note's table block (ORIGINAL_KYP_ADAPTATION). No copyrighted photographs; nothing reproduced. The page prints the 'Kompetitive inhibitors increase Km' mnemonic verbatim; the other three KYP mnemonics are original designs.
